hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","systemMessage":"Fusion loaded. Orchestrator sessions: run /fusion:setup before any other work."}}'

[ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ] && [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bin/fusion-identity" ] && { id_out="$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/fusion-identity" 2>/dev/null)" || true; p="$(printf '%s
' "$id_out" | sed -n 's/^PERSON=//p' | head -1)"; c="$(printf '%s
' "$id_out" | sed -n 's/^CHECKOUT=//p' | head -1)"; [ -n "$p" ] && printf 'export FUSION_PERSON=%q
' "$p" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; [ -n "$c" ] && printf 'export FUSION_CHECKOUT=%q
' "$c" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/fusion-checkout-name" ] && { a="$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/fusion-checkout-name" resolve "$c" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^alias=//p' | head -1)"; [ -n "$a" ] && printf 'export FUSION_ALIAS=%q
' "$a" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; }; } || true
